request.initial_prompt: Sicinius. To th' Capitol, come. We will be there before the stream o' th' people, And this shall seem, as partly 'tis, their own, Which we have goaded onward.

raw_segments.text: Sicinius, To th' Capitol, come. We will be there before the stream o' th' people,
And this shall seem, as partly teas, their own, Which we have goaded onward.
We Will Be There Before The Stream O, T.H. People, And This Shall Seem As Partly Tease
Their Own, Which We Have Goated Onward.
Sesinius, to T.H. Capital, come. We will be there before the stream O.T.H. people, and
this shall seem as partly T's their own, which we have goaded onward.
